summary: This is the whole-virion inactivated SARS-CoV-2 vaccine (BBV152, Covaxin) developed in India with an alum-imidazoquinoline adjuvant. It was given as two doses 28 days apart; current recommendations on boosters depend on national policy.
indications: Prevention of COVID-19 per national policy

dosage.n: Follow current MoHFW guidance for boosters

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Inactivated virus with adjuvant induces neutralising antibodies and T-cell responses.

absolute: Anaphylaxis to a prior dose or component

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Give the second dose as soon as possible.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
